test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is- 'virtious'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the word '**virtious**' is **incorrectly spelt **as it does not have any meaning.
 
• The correct spelling would be **virtuous**.
 
• The word **virtuous **is an **adjective **and it means *having good moral qualities and behaviour*. (अच्छे नैतिक गुण और व्यवहार होना।)
 
 
• **Example:** *He described them as **virtuous **and hard-working people.*

 
 
 

Thus ***option 2 ***is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of the other given options is:
 
 
• **glorious - **Having great beauty and splendour (महान सौंदर्य और वैभव होना)
 
• **anxious - **Worried and nervous (चिंतित और घबराया हुआ)
 
• **precious - **Of high worth or cost (उच्च मूल्य या लागत का)
